provenance.method: Editorial derivative authored through marketing:content-creation after reading the canonical dossiers/ledgers and the completed upstream context listed here. Offer facts are attributed; strategic audience/intake choices remain hypotheses. This does not alter raw runner outputs or state.

upstream_artifact_refs.use: Offer-context comparison only. Actual copy is newly authored from the canonical first-party offer ledger. Internal audit language, unsupported comparisons and any implied approval are rejected.
upstream_artifact_refs.runner_completion_claim: Only this existing artifact reports complete; no wave completion inferred.

rejected_patterns: Internal source/audit/ERP/hold caveats in prospect bodies
Counted launch, scarcity and assumed opt-in/signup prose
Invented people, testimonials, prices, savings, stock, certification, deadlines or guaranteed coverage

operator_holds: Owner approval of wording and source-supported offer claims is pending.
Brand/legal sender, sending domain, reply mailbox and signature are unbound.
Actual relevant contact, professional role and suppression/customer/opportunity checks must precede any outreach.
No Explee import is authorized: an imported campaign may send automatically.
ERP is connected for read-only references; operational writes, consent/suppression events and terminal writeback are not accepted.
Vapi calling and durable terminal event/writeback are not accepted; no call is scheduled.
Social account binding, owner approval and publication are pending.
No geographic service coverage is proven by these sources; any project feasibility must be confirmed.
Any prospect tokens must resolve to verified current data or the optional clause must be omitted.

sender_and_signature.implementation_hold: Bind a real authorized sender and monitored mailbox; never synthesize personal identity, address, phone or signature.

regionalization.base: National-neutral French wording; no service-area promise.
regionalization.optional_opening: Votre établissement est situé dans le département {{department}}.
regionalization.allowed_if: Actual establishment department is verified from the correct current SIRET record; do not use legal-headquarters geography as an installation coverage claim.
regionalization.token_substitution: department must be a verified readable French department name/code. Omit the whole sentence if absent, ambiguous or stale; never send a literal token.
regionalization.word_count_policy: If the optional sentence is added, recheck total body length against the channel range; it must not add a second CTA.

footer_policy.text: Si vous préférez ne plus recevoir nos messages, dites-le-nous simplement en réponse.
footer_policy.implementation_gate: Before use, verify the monitored reply inbox, identify opt-out replies, persist suppression across relevant brand campaigns, stop pending follow-ups and verify suppression before every send. This package implements no opt-out handling.

emails.subject: Éclairage ou pilotage : votre besoin
emails.body:
Bonjour,

Votre activité vous amène à préparer un lot éclairage ou une fonction de pilotage du bâtiment ? Le groupe Axtech réunit notamment Ecoled Europe pour l’éclairage LED professionnel et HeyZack pour l’automatisation des bâtiments résidentiels et commerciaux. Nous vous proposons un premier échange pour situer le besoin de votre projet, le métier concerné et les équipements à examiner avec la marque pertinente.

Pouvez-vous nous préciser si votre besoin porte sur l’éclairage ou le pilotage ?

emails.subject: Un projet d’intérieur avec Kartezzi
emails.body:
Bonjour,

Votre projet d’intérieur comporte des matières décoratives ou un agencement à concevoir sur mesure ? Kartezzi, marque du groupe Axtech, propose notamment des panneaux et finitions, de la menuiserie, du mobilier, des cuisines et des portes. L’échange peut partir des plans, des dimensions et des usages souhaités, avec une réflexion sur l’éclairage intégré aux éléments d’agencement lorsque le projet le prévoit.

Pouvez-vous nous décrire le lot d’intérieur que vous souhaitez examiner ?
